label: Purdue adults, whole bodies
platform: Oxford Nanopore MinION (R9 flow cells, ligation library)
animal: wild adults from a canal in the Florida Keys (isolate ECLA1), starved for at least two weeks; DNA from whole bodies, used for the Purdue assembly
note: All eleven runs, from five flow cells, analysed in full and aligned to the Purdue assembly. The archive record refers to adults in the plural and does not state how many animals contributed DNA.

label: Purdue adults, brains
platform: Oxford Nanopore MinION (R9 flow cell, ligation library)
animal: brains dissected from wild adults of the same isolate (ECLA1)
note: The single run, analysed in full and aligned to the Purdue assembly.

label: Purdue egg mass
animal: an egg mass of the same isolate (ECLA1), collected within 24 hours of deposition: germline DNA, which contains no ingested algal material
note: The complete library, aligned to the Purdue assembly.

label: Tampa long-read library
animal: an animal collected at Pickles Reef, Key Largo, Florida, and sequenced at the University of Tampa; library EC2, made by whole-genome amplification
note: The complete run, aligned to the Tampa assembly.

label: Tampa short-read library
animal: a second animal, registered in the archive under the same sample record as the long-read library; library EC1
note: The complete library, aligned to the Tampa assembly.

label: Assembled individual
animal: the individual used for the assembly (specimen xgElyPapi4, Tampa, Florida, 2024)
note: Both long-read runs from this specimen, analysed in full.

label: Second individual
animal: a second individual (specimen xgElyPapi1, a whole adult, Tampa, Florida, 2024)
note: The long-read run from the other specimen sequenced for the same project, analysed in full.

label: Assembled individual
animal: the individual used for the assembly (adult, Qingdao, China, 2024)
note: The single long-read run used for the assembly, analysed in full.

label: Assembled individuals
animal: the individuals used for the assembly (adults, Cadaqués, Spain)
note: The complete Revio run used for the assembly. The library was amplified by PCR.

label: Adult, long reads
animal: an adult (isolate EC2010, Martha’s Vineyard), the source of the long reads used for the assembly

label: Second adult, short reads
platform: Illumina HiSeq 2000 (paired-end; inserts of 170, 500 and 800 bp)
animal: a second adult, the source of the short reads used for the assembly
note: All six paired-end libraries from this adult, analysed in full. The mate-pair libraries, which were made from other individuals, were excluded.

label: Eggs, short reads
animal: eggs (germline DNA; Bhattacharya et al. 2013), which contain no chloroplasts because the animals have not yet fed
note: Both runs of the egg DNA library.

label: Assembled individual
platform: Illumina HiSeq 2500 (paired-end; inserts of 250 and 500 bp)
animal: the individual used for the assembly (one animal, Kagoshima, Japan, 2013)
note: Both paired-end libraries used for the assembly, analysed in full. The reads are deposited in the archive under the name Elysia ornata. The mate-pair libraries were excluded.

label: Shenzhen individual
animal: a different individual (isolate SZU-EL01, Shenzhen, China, 2025), not the one used for the assembly
note: The complete shotgun library that was used to assemble the mitochondrial genome QB170827.

label: Hainan individual
animal: a different individual (genome-survey library, Hainan University), not the one used for the assembly
note: The complete library. No reads from the assembled individual are publicly available.
